title: A composite electrolyte with homogeneous heat and ion transfer for high-safety solid-state lithium batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03638K, Paper
Shun Lv, Ke Yang, Di Zhao, Xiandi Ma, Mengwei Sun, Chang Liu, Yiteng Ma, Likun Chen, Junyao You, Yun Tian, Xu Zhang, Zhen Zhou, Yan-Bing He, Feiyu Kang
A composite electrolyte with homogeneous heat and ion transfer pathways was designed, enabling solid-state Li‖LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 cells to achieve robust cyclability under high rates, high cathode loadings, and elevated temperatures.
